status: Exploratory hardware-informed simulation, fixed before this run. Not physical execution or independent preregistration. Detector and previous failures already known.
source: Pinned QASMBench source artifacts archived in results/false-positives-v1/sources/QASMBench; source commit 357b942396d5c2b7cbc1c229c585a6ef5ccaebac. Reused sources, not unseen workloads.
layouts: First two disjoint connected paths in lexicographic physical-qubit order, selected using topology only before results; route within each selected subgraph.
noise: Aer NoiseModel.from_backend, restricted to the selected connected physical-qubit subgraph with physical identifiers retained in provenance. Backend-derived depolarization plus thermal gate relaxation and asymmetric readout. Scheduled delays receive RelaxationNoisePass using per-qubit T1/T2 and device dt. No added noise for virtual RZ unless present in the snapshot. No general crosstalk, leakage or non-Markovian model.
numerics: Reject density normalization error >=1e-7; otherwise record the correction before renormalization. Backend Kraus serialization can accumulate floating-point errors. This is a simulator numerical contract, not a detection threshold.
definitions: Visible X/Z/CX/RZ and SWAP are trusted circuit-level interventions before basis rotations, not clandestine hardware faults. Parameter scaling multiplies every source rotation parameter by 1.1. Equivalent optimized uses optimization_level=3 before target compilation and must pass a 1e-9 ideal operator check; a failed optional rewrite is reported, not used as an attack or exclusion of the original. Benign drift doubles each readout assignment error, capped at 0.5, while retaining gate channels. Calibration uses only original clean observations.
criteria: Per raw hardware/layout/workload/acquisition context: clean Wilson95 upper<=0.10 and each declared strong mutation X/Z/CX Wilson95 lower>=0.90. Report all cases and every failure; no claim all strong mutations act observably on all circuits. Weak, equivalent, SWAP and drift are diagnostic outcomes, never relabeled to improve success.
sampling: Compute exact noisy density-matrix distributions, then draw independent multinomial counts with recorded seeds. References and calibration acquisitions are separate random draws from a fixed saved calibration model; this measures sampling/calibration uncertainty, not independent physical recalibrations. Apply asymmetric classical readout explicitly once after saved premeasurement probabilities.
verification: Use unchanged Rust JointVerifier through the CLI joint_score operation on every evaluation batch; independently reconstruct threshold and score. Preserve full compact ISA circuits, schedule/delays, noise model, selected physical indices, complete original backend properties/configuration and hashes. Gate/assignment probabilities must normalize. Physical QPU shots=0.
